mapper.sql: id, user_id, trip_id, activity_id, place_id, review_id, location_name, custom_name, latitude, longitude, accuracy_meters, ward, district, province, province_code, location_source, location_key, caption, overall_rating, food_rating, price_rating, ambiance_rating, service_rating, photo_source, visibility, verification_status, verification_scope, ward_code, distance_meters, idempotency_key, reward_points, reward_reason, is_removed, visited_at, edited_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_checkins (id, user_id, trip_id, activity_id, place_id, review_id, location_name, custom_name, latitude, longitude, accuracy_meters, ward, district, province, province_code, location_source, location_key, caption, overall_rating, food_rating, price_rating, ambiance_rating, service_rating, photo_source, visibility, verification_status, verification_scope, ward_code, distance_meters, idempotency_key, is_removed, visited_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{tripId}, #{activityId}, #{placeId}, #{reviewId}, #{locationName}, #{customName}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{accuracyMeters}, #{ward}, #{district}, #{province}, #{provinceCode}, #{locationSource}, #{locationKey}, #{caption}, #{overallRating}, #{foodRating}, #{priceRating}, #{ambianceRating}, #{serviceRating}, #{photoSource}, #{visibility}, #{verificationStatus}, COALESCE(#{verificationScope}, 'NONE'), #{wardCode}, #{distanceMeters}, #{idempotencyKey}, FALSE, COALESCE(#{visitedAt}, #{createdAt}), #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_checkins SET verification_status = #{verificationStatus}, verification_scope = COALESCE(#{verificationScope}, 'NONE'), ward_code = #{wardCode}, ward = #{ward}, province = #{province}, province_code = #{provinceCode}, distance_meters = #{distanceMeters}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_removed = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT v.ward_code AS wardCode, w.province_code AS provinceCode, w.full_name AS wardName, p.name AS provinceName, SUM(v.visit_count)::int AS checkinCount, SUM(v.verified_count)::int AS verifiedCount, MAX(v.last_visit_at) AS lastCheckinAt FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(cp.ward_code, c.ward_code) AS ward_code, COUNT(*) AS visit_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.verification_status = 'VERIFIED') AS verified_count, MAX(c.visited_at) AS last_visit_at FROM user_checkins c LEFT JOIN places cp ON cp.id = c.place_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.is_removed = FALSE AND COALESCE(cp.ward_code, c.ward_code) IS NOT NULL AND c.visibility = 'PUBLIC' GROUP BY COALESCE(cp.ward_code, c.ward_code) UNION ALL SELECT rp.ward_code, COUNT(*), 0, MAX(r.created_at) FROM user_reviews r JOIN places rp ON rp.id = r.place_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND rp.ward_code IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_checkins lc WHERE lc.review_id = r.id AND lc.is_removed = FALSE) GROUP BY rp.ward_code ) v JOIN wards w ON w.code = v.ward_code JOIN provinces p ON p.code = w.province_code GROUP BY v.ward_code, w.province_code, w.full_name, p.name ORDER BY MAX(v.last_visit_at) DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE user_checkins SET caption = #{caption}, custom_name = #{customName}, overall_rating = #{overallRating}, food_rating = #{foodRating}, price_rating = #{priceRating}, ambiance_rating = #{ambianceRating}, service_rating = #{serviceRating}, visibility = #{visibility}, review_id = #{reviewId}, visited_at = COALESCE(#{visitedAt}, visited_at), edited_at = #{editedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_removed = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_checkins WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT FROM user_checkins WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT FROM user_checkins WHERE visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND is_removed = FALSE AND user_id <> #{excludeUserId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_takedowns t WHERE t.content_type = 'CHECKIN' AND t.content_id = user_checkins.id AND t.restored_at IS NULL) ORDER BY EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_assets ma WHERE ma.entity_type = 'USER_CHECKIN' AND ma.entity_id = user_checkins.id AND (ma.asset_role IS NULL OR ma.asset_role = 'PHOTO') AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL) DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_checkins WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_removed = FALSE AND visibility = 'PUBLIC'

SELECT FROM user_checkins WHERE place_id = #{placeId} AND visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND is_removed = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_takedowns t WHERE t.content_type = 'CHECKIN' AND t.content_id = user_checkins.id AND t.restored_at IS NULL) ORDER BY visited_at DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT FROM user_checkins WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND is_removed = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_takedowns t WHERE t.content_type = 'CHECKIN' AND t.content_id = user_checkins.id AND t.restored_at IS NULL) ORDER BY visited_at ASC, created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) FROM user_checkins WHERE place_id = #{placeId} AND overall_rating IS NOT NULL AND review_id IS NOT NULL AND visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND is_removed = FALSE ORDER BY user_id, created_at DESC

SELECT FROM user_checkins WHERE location_key = #{locationKey} AND visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND is_removed = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_takedowns t WHERE t.content_type = 'CHECKIN' AND t.content_id = user_checkins.id AND t.restored_at IS NULL) ORDER BY visited_at DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) FROM user_checkins WHERE location_key = #{locationKey} AND overall_rating IS NOT NULL AND is_removed = FALSE ORDER BY user_id, created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE user_checkins SET is_removed = TRUE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_removed = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT c.id FROM user_checkins c WHERE c.is_removed = TRUE AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_assets p WHERE p.entity_type = 'USER_CHECKIN' AND p.entity_id = c.id AND (p.asset_role IS NULL OR p.asset_role = 'PHOTO') AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ) ORDER BY c.updated_at ASC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_checkins SET place_id = #{placeId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE location_key = #{locationKey} AND place_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_checkins WHERE location_key = #{locationKey} AND place_id = #{placeId} AND is_removed = FALSE ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1000
mapper.update: UPDATE user_checkins SET review_id = #{reviewId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_checkins SET review_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
UPDATE user_checkins SET reward_points = #{rewardPoints}, reward_reason = #{rewardReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND reward_points IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(reward_points), 0) FROM user_checkins WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= #{since} AND reward_points IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO media_assets (id, trip_id, activity_id, entity_type, entity_id, media_type, url, asset_role, position, caption, description, taken_at, latitude, longitude, accuracy_meters, capture_source, date_source, place_id, location_name, location_source, uploaded_by, created_at, updated_at) SELECT #{id}, c.trip_id, c.activity_id, 'USER_CHECKIN', c.id, 'IMAGE', #{url}, 'PHOTO', #{position}, #{title}, #{description}, #{capturedAt}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{accuracyMeters}, #{source},
'CAPTURE' 'UPLOAD' , c.place_id, c.location_name, c.location_source, c.user_id, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt} FROM user_checkins c WHERE c.id = #{checkinId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, entity_id AS checkin_id, url, capture_source AS source, position, caption AS title, description, taken_at AS captured_at, latitude, longitude, accuracy_meters, created_at FROM media_assets WHERE entity_type = 'USER_CHECKIN' AND entity_id = #{checkinId} AND (asset_role IS NULL OR asset_role = 'PHOTO') AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY position
mapper.delete: UPDATE media_assets SET deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE entity_type = 'USER_CHECKIN' AND entity_id = #{checkinId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_checkin_likes WHERE checkin_id = #{checkinId} AND user_id = #{userId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_checkin_likes (checkin_id, user_id) VALUES (#{checkinId}, #{userId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_checkin_likes WHERE checkin_id = #{checkinId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_checkin_likes WHERE checkin_id = #{checkinId}
SELECT checkin_id AS "checkinId", COUNT(*) AS "likeCount" FROM user_checkin_likes WHERE checkin_id IN #{id} GROUP BY checkin_id
mapper.sql: FROM user_checkins c LEFT JOIN checkin_cluster_decisions d ON d.location_key = c.location_key WHERE c.place_id IS NULL AND c.is_removed = FALSE AND (d.location_key IS NULL OR (d.status = 'IGNORED' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_checkins x WHERE x.location_key = c.location_key) >= d.checkin_count_at_decision * 1.5)) GROUP BY c.location_key HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) >= #{minUsers} AND COUNT(*) >= #{minCheckins}
mapper.select:
SELECT c.location_key, (array_agg(c.location_name ORDER BY c.created_at))[1] AS common_name, string_agg(DISTINCT c.location_name, ' | ') AS alternate_names, AVG(c.latitude) AS centroid_latitude, AVG(c.longitude) AS centroid_longitude, (array_agg(c.ward) FILTER (WHERE c.ward IS NOT NULL))[1] AS ward, (array_agg(c.district) FILTER (WHERE c.district IS NOT NULL))[1] AS district, (array_agg(c.province) FILTER (WHERE c.province IS NOT NULL))[1] AS province, (array_agg(c.province_code) FILTER (WHERE c.province_code IS NOT NULL))[1] AS province_code, COUNT(*) AS checkin_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS distinct_user_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.overall_rating IS NOT NULL) AS rated_checkin_count, MIN(c.created_at) AS first_seen_at, MAX(c.created_at) AS last_seen_at, (SELECT string_agg(p.url, ',') FROM (SELECT url FROM media_assets ph JOIN user_checkins uc ON uc.id = ph.entity_id WHERE ph.entity_type = 'USER_CHECKIN' AND (ph.asset_role IS NULL OR ph.asset_role = 'PHOTO') AND ph.deleted_at IS NULL AND uc.location_key = c.location_key ORDER BY ph.created_at DESC LIMIT 4) p) AS sample_photos
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) DESC, COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.location_key ) AS clusters

SELECT c.location_key, (array_agg(c.location_name ORDER BY c.created_at))[1] AS common_name, string_agg(DISTINCT c.location_name, ' | ') AS alternate_names, AVG(c.latitude) AS centroid_latitude, AVG(c.longitude) AS centroid_longitude, (array_agg(c.ward) FILTER (WHERE c.ward IS NOT NULL))[1] AS ward, (array_agg(c.district) FILTER (WHERE c.district IS NOT NULL))[1] AS district, (array_agg(c.province) FILTER (WHERE c.province IS NOT NULL))[1] AS province, (array_agg(c.province_code) FILTER (WHERE c.province_code IS NOT NULL))[1] AS province_code, COUNT(*) AS checkin_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS distinct_user_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.overall_rating IS NOT NULL) AS rated_checkin_count, MIN(c.created_at) AS first_seen_at, MAX(c.created_at) AS last_seen_at, NULL AS sample_photos FROM user_checkins c WHERE c.location_key = #{locationKey} AND c.is_removed = FALSE GROUP BY c.location_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO checkin_cluster_decisions (location_key, status, place_id, decided_by, decided_at, note, checkin_count_at_decision) VALUES (#{locationKey}, #{status}, #{placeId}, #{decidedBy}, #{decidedAt}, #{note}, #{checkinCountAtDecision}) ON CONFLICT (location_key) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, place_id = EXCLUDED.place_id, decided_by = EXCLUDED.decided_by, decided_at = EXCLUDED.decided_at, note = EXCLUDED.note, checkin_count_at_decision = EXCLUDED.checkin_count_at_decision
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM checkin_cluster_decisions WHERE location_key = #{locationKey}
